name: ui-draw-sprite
description: DrawSprite — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui draw-sprite pattern).

schema.name: ui-draw-sprite
schema.description: DrawSprite — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui draw-sprite pattern).

width.label: Width
width.description: Draw width in world units (fractions of `projector.tileWidth`). Omitted → one cell on tile grids (`flat`/`iso`/`hex`); native source px on `free`/`side`.

anchor.label: Anchor
anchor.description: How the sprite aligns to its projected position. Default `'top-left'`.

rotation.label: Rotation
rotation.description: Rotation in radians about the sprite's center.

position.label: Position
position.description: Logical scene position; the projector maps it to pixels / world.

asset.label: Asset
asset.description: The image / atlas reference to blit.

frame.label: Frame
frame.description: Explicit atlas sub-rect override (px); omitted → resolved from `asset.atlas`/`asset.sprite`.

loop.label: Loop
loop.description: Override the sheet row's loop flag. The paint clock is wall-time, so one-shot rows hold their final frame — preview pages set `true` to cycle attack/hit/death continuously.

height.label: Height
height.description: Draw height in world units (fractions of `projector.tileWidth`). Omitted → one cell on tile grids (`flat`/`iso`/`hex`); native source px on `free`/`side`.

animation.label: Animation
animation.description: Animation to play. 3D backend: a named GLB clip (matched case-insensitively). 2D painter: when `asset.atlas` resolves to a `SpriteSheetAtlas` manifest, the canonical row of that name (idle/walk/attack/hit/death) plays off the host paint clock; an explicit `frame` rect overrides.
